title: Unique paths with obstacles
statement: Count the paths from the top-left to the bottom-right of a grid moving only right or down, avoiding cells marked 1. (Answers fit in 64 bits.)
hints: Paths into a cell come from above or from the left.
One row of state suffices: dp[j] += dp[j − 1].

solution.explanation: dp[i][j] = dp[i−1][j] + dp[i][j−1], and 0 at obstacles. Rolling one row: before the update dp[j] still holds the cell above, and dp[j−1] has already been updated to the cell on the left. Note the start cell itself may be an obstacle.
